source: Iced-Cream's own test on their unit: the core-ar2 0.6 unit test (V6H4, 2026-10-23) of rytm2_mods' voice-dac 1.4 source (rytm2_mods 77bd329, whose voice-dac/os1.74, include and shared files are identical to the v1.4 tag 01254ab)
statement: Hardware, Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, 2026-10-23, V6H4 (core-ar2 0.6 with all eleven rytm2_mods ports, voice-dac 1.4 among them, plus analoghealth for remote keys): with DAC SUM on, FILTER pressed twice opened DAC FILTER; TYP OFF showed TYP and DEP only with the empty knobs inert; LP2, BP, HP2, BS and PK showed FRQ and RES, LP1 and HP1 FRQ only; the page followed BD (LP1) to SD (OFF) and back; RES was kept across LP2, LP1 and LP2; BD on LP2, LP1 and OFF played without dropouts, checked by ear with no click or break; after SAVE KIT, a power cycle and RELOAD, DAC SUM was still ON and BD's LP1 setting came back. The other ten mods behaved as in v1.3.
scope: voice-dac 1.4 beside the other ten rytm2_mods ports and analoghealth on core-ar2 0.6, not on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7).

builds.label: V6H4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.6 (6d5302f) with rytm2_mods' eleven OS 1.74 mods, voice-dac 1.4 built from 77bd329, plus analoghealth 1.2 for remote keys. Flashed by the owner, test steps run through remote keys and by hand, stock 1.74 restored.
results: DAC FILTER by TYP: OFF shows TYP and DEP only; LP1 and HP1 hide RES; the empty knobs are inert.
The page follows the track: BD (LP1) to SD (OFF) and back.
RES kept across LP2, LP1, LP2.
BD on LP2, LP1 and OFF: no dropouts; checked by ear, no click or break.
SAVE KIT, power cycle, RELOAD: DAC SUM still ON, BD back on LP1 at its saved FRQ.

limitations: Core-ar2 0.6, not Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7); this package has not been flashed.
V6H4's voice-dac object was built from 77bd329 before the v1.4 release; its source equals v1.4's, but its bytes were not compared with the v1.4 release object.
Duration was not recorded; firmware was not read back from the device.
No v1.3 reference recording, so the sound was not compared with an earlier version.
